steps.title: Remove the back cover screws
lines: Use a JIS 00 screwdriver to loosen the 4.2 mm‑long screws on the top edge of the back cover.
The screws have locking washers that prevent the screws from falling out. Keep these in place.

steps.title: Remove the back cover
lines: Use a plastic opening tool to pry off the clips securing the back cover, starting at the top corners and working your way down.
Use your hands to keep the clips from reattaching.
Use your hands to remove the back cover.
Insert the plastic opening tool into the opening located on the right side of the battery.
Pry the battery out of its recess and remove it.
